content.text: No transition or data-return provision exists. I'll propose an insertion after the Termination section.

input.summary: Insert transition assistance and Client data return/deletion obligations into Section 14 (Termination).
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit provision to Section 14: on expiry or termination TrueLink provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then deletes and certifies deletion. The Agreement currently requires us to arrange a new hosting environment within 60 days but gives us no right to our own data or migration help, which is unworkable for borrower and loan data. We can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return to Client all Client Content, Credit Data and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law.
